kennedy-dapam-20-255.title: The German Campaign in Poland (1939)
kennedy-dapam-20-255.publisher: Department of the Army, DA Pam 20-255 (HyperWar 轉錄)
kennedy-dapam-20-255.gradeBasis: 美國陸軍官方出版 DA Pam 20-255 原件為 A；此為 HyperWar 第三方轉錄本，依現行來源規則記 B

body.zh-Hant: 1939年9月波蘭戰役期間，德軍以邊境指揮部的營、第62步兵師的一個團及第252步兵師部分單位組成特遣群，稱為吉南特群（Group Gienanth），負責防衛南方集團軍群暴露的左翼。
body.en: During the September 1939 Polish campaign, German frontier-command battalions, a regiment of the 62d Infantry Division and elements of the 252d Infantry Division were formed into a task force called Group Gienanth, responsible for defending Army Group South's exposed left flank.

citations.locator: Part Three, Chapter 6, Army Group South 1-6 September
citations.quote: organized into a task force known as Group Gienanth
citations.evidenceNote: 來源只稱 Group Gienanth，未寫指揮官全名與日期

citations.claimSpan: 防衛南方集團軍群暴露左翼
